rounds.title: SQL Interview
rounds.description: Two result-graded SQL questions on joins, filters and aggregation.

questions.context: Return completed revenue by customer segment.
questions.prompt: Using customers and orders, return segment and total_revenue for completed orders.
questions.explanation: Join on customer_id, filter status before aggregation and group at the requested segment grain.

questions.prompt: Return region and total_revenue for completed orders only.
questions.explanation: Join customer geography to orders, exclude non-completed statuses and aggregate by region.
